text: Feasibility prototype attached to bd-01KZXD7G0E5KEDMC2VCGVKGNS7 before this epic starts. Canonical accumulation is achievable at ~2x naive cost, not 27x. Key rule: fix the GEMM tile SHAPE and let the workspace budget control tile COUNT only - the 1-ULP drift comes from BLAS switching kernels on shape changes, not from your reduction order. Bucket supports into a small fixed set of canonical widths using the Epic 1 support-size distribution to bound padding waste.
